binding_offset_m.formula: documented nearest distance in EPSG:4548 between the OSM-mapped completed park portion and PROV-SITE-001
binding_offset_m.reason: This conflict reading triggers whole-model rebinding; it does not prove that either provisional geometry or incomplete OSM park mapping is an official boundary.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: area(union of authored reference-prototype footprints in EPSG:4548)

changeover_field_noninferiority_rate.formula: requires authorised same-task A/B/H pilot with preregistered margin
changeover_field_noninferiority_rate.reason: No live public-service model, user session, site operation or field-performance observation was executed; one separate local offline BGE-M3 semantic witness is registered under semantic_witness_* metrics.

changeover_field_trial_count.formula: field trials executed by this verifier

changeover_honor_display_count.formula: count(site topologies with a public redacted Delta Receipt wall)

changeover_live_model_run_count.formula: live model calls executed by this verifier

changeover_two_key_coverage_ratio.formula: contracts with two independent decision keys / contracts

changeover_unsafe_promotion_count.formula: unsafe injected candidates incorrectly made eligible

changeover_witness_landmark_count.formula: count(LM-ABH witness-landmark records in verified topology set)

dazhongsi_context_feature_count.formula: count(OSM-derived orientation features in the pinned 750 m snapshot)

dazhongsi_first_bay_anchor_distance_m.formula: distance from OSM station-anchor midpoint to participant-authored geometry-only test centre in EPSG:4548

dazhongsi_first_bay_mapped_collision_are.formula: intersection(test envelope, mapped buildings buffered 4m + rail 10m + station-access points 8m + approximate mapped-street buffers)
dazhongsi_first_bay_mapped_collision_are.reason: Zero mapped collision is only an orientation-screen result; it does not prove a vacant or buildable parcel.

dazhongsi_literal_frame_mapped_intersect.formula: count(OSM mapping records intersecting a literal station-centred 148m × 148m reference frame)
dazhongsi_literal_frame_mapped_intersect.reason: Counts mapping records, not unique physical objects; the result rejects literal placement but does not establish a lawful alternative site.

dazhongsi_overlay_to_provisional_key_edg.formula: distance(OSM station-record midpoint, submitted provisional PROV-KEY-003 edge) in EPSG:4548
dazhongsi_overlay_to_provisional_key_edg.reason: Neither geometry is official; the separation is disclosed rather than resolved by assumption.

dazhongsi_overlay_to_submitted_room_cent.formula: distance(OSM station-record midpoint, submitted provisional ROOM-EXCHANGE centroid) in EPSG:4548
dazhongsi_overlay_to_submitted_room_cent.reason: The separation proves this station test-fit is a separate non-authoritative overlay; it does not silently relocate the submitted geometry.

dazhongsi_p0_opex_working_high_million_c.formula: 18h/day × 365 / 1,680 productive h/FTE × 1.20 leave/training = 4.69 → five-FTE roster; participant high working allowance adds cleaning, maintenance, insurance and audit; 24h night operation is excluded

dazhongsi_p0_opex_working_low_million_cn.formula: 18h/day × 365 / 1,680 productive h/FTE × 1.20 leave/training = 4.69 → five-FTE roster; participant low working allowance adds cleaning, maintenance, insurance and audit

dazhongsi_p0_rom_cost_high_million_cny.formula: 1.35 × (64 sqm × ¥9,000/sqm structure/roof + 256 sqm × ¥2,500/sqm ground + ¥0.55m interfaces + ¥0.35m furniture/help + ¥0.70m survey/design)

dazhongsi_p0_rom_cost_low_million_cny.formula: 1.35 × (64 sqm × ¥5,000/sqm structure/roof + 256 sqm × ¥1,200/sqm ground + ¥0.25m interfaces + ¥0.15m furniture/help + ¥0.35m survey/design)

delivery_authorised_participant_count.formula: count(authorised participants recorded by the field-baseline protocol)

delivery_conditional_program_reference_w.formula: count(unique reference weeks occupied by T01-T11 after documentary T0; not an approved programme)

delivery_conditional_program_timed_activ.formula: count(T01-T11 timed activities occupying the conditional W1-W15 reference window after accepted T0)

delivery_external_gate_hold_count.formula: count(external gates with missing documentary evidence and release=HOLD)

delivery_field_baseline_count.formula: count(authorised field baseline receipts in dossier)

delivery_field_observation_count.formula: count completed field observations recorded by the protocol

delivery_gate_handoff_template_count.formula: count(G01-G12 preparer-future document issuer or accountable-party class-reviewer-acceptor handoff templates)

delivery_guide_module_count.formula: count(mapped modules in 京建发〔2024〕182号)

delivery_permit_or_consent_granted_count.formula: count(external permits or consents evidenced as granted in dossier)

delivery_raci_single_accountability_rati.formula: conditional activities with exactly one Accountable / all conditional activities

delivery_unsafe_site_release_count.formula: count(site/construction/opening releases emitted without all external evidence)

design_root_count.formula: count(independent typed spatial roots in immutable harness run)

direct_sun_sample_count.formula: count(30-minute NREL-SPA sun positions across one winter and two hot-season windows)

direct_sun_variant_count.formula: 3 prototypes × 5 orientations × 3 building-height scales × 4 tree states

exchange_approaches_summer_architecture_.formula: mean June/July approach points shaded by buildings ∪ fixed roofs ∪ hot-season cassettes
exchange_approaches_summer_architecture_.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

exchange_approaches_summer_worst_interva.formula: minimum 30-minute June/July architecture shade fraction across four approaches
exchange_approaches_summer_worst_interva.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

exchange_approaches_winter_architecture_.formula: area-weighted mean winter direct-sun potential across four exterior approaches
exchange_approaches_winter_architecture_.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Official site boundary, approved floor-area controls and existing floor area are absent.

gate_challenge_false_accept_count.formula: count(injected fault cases accepted by all hard exclusion conditions)

green_space_area_sqm.formula: area(union of authored green-space polygons in EPSG:4548)

handoff_minefield_hit_count.formula: count(forbidden minefield events in encoded recovery traces)

handoff_recovery_pass_count.formula: count(encoded recovery traces reaching their declared safe final state)

handoff_unsafe_action_count.formula: count(unsafe continuation actions in encoded recovery traces)

model_swap_task_count.formula: count(model-swap invariance tasks across selected prototypes)

operating_actor_count.formula: count(participant-authored accountable role types; not appointments)

origin_courts_winter_architecture_unshad.formula: court receptor points with at least two sampled winter direct-sun hours
origin_courts_winter_architecture_unshad.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

origin_courts_winter_architecture_unshad.formula: area-weighted mean winter direct-sun potential across three outdoor courts, buildings + fixed typed roofs
origin_courts_winter_architecture_unshad.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

origin_lane_summer_architecture_shade_fr.formula: mean June/July public-lane points shaded by buildings ∪ fixed typed roofs
origin_lane_summer_architecture_shade_fr.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

origin_lane_summer_worst_interval_archit.formula: minimum 30-minute June/July public-lane architecture shade fraction
origin_lane_summer_worst_interval_archit.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

p0_alternative_pair_count.formula: four compared-alternative pairs where the rejected option genuinely wins on at least one named dimension and is wired as the fallback branch of a named gate

p0_budget_class_count.formula: four participant budget classes expressed as shares of participant ROM: documents and survey 10%, assembly and reversible ground 60%, service interfaces 12%, first-year operating readiness 18%; no amounts, no quotations, no formal estimate

p0_calculated_minimum_fte.formula: 18 public-service hours/day x 365 / 1,680 productive hours per FTE x 1.20 leave and training factor
p0_calculated_minimum_fte.display_unit: FTE; five-FTE working roster, 0 uncovered hours

p0_covered_bay_occupancy_cap_person.formula: 64 sqm demountable covered bay / 4 sqm per person participant cap

p0_design_area_per_person_sqm.formula: participant-set standing comfort allowance for open public ground; a design cap chosen by the participant, not a code occupancy limit and not a professional life-safety conclusion

p0_exit_count.formula: three open-air exits from the reversible ground, matching the single-queue three-exit topology

p0_field_dependent_acceptance_indicator_.formula: count of acceptance indicators whose threshold status is baseline_ratification_required (I09-I12), held TBC until an authorised field baseline is ratified

p0_h_desk_service_rate_person_per_hour.formula: 60 min / 4 min participant-set mean H-desk service time, one staffed desk; above this arrival rate the single queue requires a second staffed desk or the queue cap holds

p0_immediately_judgeable_acceptance_indi.formula: count of acceptance indicators whose threshold status is participant_design_hold_rule (I01-I08), judgeable without any future field data

p0_maintenance_cycle_count.formula: daily, weekly, quarterly and annual maintenance cycles bound to the commissioning list rollback_drill and decommissioning_rehearsal

p0_max_travel_distance_to_open_air_m.formula: half-diagonal of the 16 m x 16 m reversible ground = sqrt(8^2 + 8^2); the porch is open-air on all sides, so this is a walking distance, not a fire-compartment conclusion

p0_minimum_exit_clear_width_m.formula: participant-set minimum clear width per exit for wheelchair passing; not a certified egress calculation

p0_restoration_reserve_ratio.formula: participant-set ring-fenced restoration and decommissioning reserve as a share of participant ROM, held outside the ROM and released only on decommissioning; not a funding commitment

p0_reversible_ground_occupancy_cap_perso.formula: 256 sqm reversible ground / 4 sqm per person participant cap

p0_total_exit_clear_width_m.formula: 3 exits x 1.5 m participant-set clear width

proof_route_summer_architecture_shade_fr.formula: mean June/July route points shaded by buildings ∪ active typed roofs
proof_route_summer_architecture_shade_fr.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

proof_route_summer_worst_interval_archit.formula: minimum 30-minute June/July route shade fraction from buildings ∪ active typed roofs
proof_route_summer_worst_interval_archit.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

proof_route_winter_architecture_unshadow.formula: mean direct-sun potential on the 3 m observation-route receptor, buildings + fixed typed roof
proof_route_winter_architecture_unshadow.reason: Geometry-only NREL-SPA sensitivity study; not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, UTCI/MRT, wind or approval evidence.

public_space_area_sqm.formula: area(union of authored public-space polygons in EPSG:4548)

semantic_witness_disagreement_count.formula: count(B top-1 topology unequal to participant-authored A/reference label)

semantic_witness_hardstop_hold_count.formula: count(hard-stop fixtures superseded by deterministic H gate)

semantic_witness_nonhardstop_agreement_c.formula: count(non-hard-stop B top-1 topology equal to participant-authored label)

semantic_witness_promotion_count.formula: count(model promotions or deployments executed by witness)

semantic_witness_topology_agreement_coun.formula: count(B top-1 topology equal to participant-authored A/reference label)

semantic_witness_topology_agreement_rati.formula: 29 / 36; participant-authored labels are not independent truth

shared_floor_duplicate_feature_id_count.formula: count(duplicate ids across selected-root masses, routes and public rooms)

shared_floor_public_room_route_gap_count.formula: count(public rooms not touched by selected-root public-route network)

shared_floor_public_route_component_coun.formula: count(geometrically connected public-route components in normalized selected root)

shared_floor_summer_public_shade_proxy.formula: normalized outdoor public-room area intersecting summer-noon mass/tree-canopy shadow proxy

shared_floor_winter_public_sun_proxy.formula: normalized outdoor public-room area not intersecting winter-noon mass/tree shadow proxy

targeted_fault_detection_count.formula: count(injected faults rejected by their declared expected failure condition)
